subject: CSA assertion index & runtime log provisioning for Sentinel POC
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <security@sentinelhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CSA questions for Sentinel POC - control list and evidence

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we move the POC forward, our security team needs a compact view of Redwood's CSA (CAIQ) assertions mapped to the controls we care about, plus a pragmatic set of runtime artifacts we can validate during the POC.

High-level ask: can you provide a single assertion index (control -> Redwood claim) and a short export of runtime logs/artifacts for the last 14 days for the POC tenant? Specifically we need:
- CSA CCM control cross-reference (CSV or PDF): pointer to the exact sub-controls you claim
- Runtime request/response telemetry for the POC tenant (redacted identifiers OK) for the past 14 days
- KV cache access pattern / eviction proof for inference requests
- Key management statement (KMS/HSM) and proof of key rotation cadence
- Network diagram showing tenant segregation and egress controls

I've attached a short worksheet that lists the control IDs our reviewers will score (column A). If you can populate the assertion column and attach the artifact names/paths that would be ideal.

Attachment: [Sentinel_CSA_Questions_1109.xlsx (XLSX stub)]

We'd like to review the assertion index by EOD Wednesday (US PST) if possible.

Thank you — happy to hop on a quick call to align scope.

Best,
Priya Sharma
Security Program Manager
Sentinel Health
security@sentinelhealth.com

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <security@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CSA questions for Sentinel POC - control list and evidence

Hi Priya,

Thanks — we can do that. I've pulled together a lightweight plan to deliver what you asked for and flagged owners. High level timeline:
- Day 1 (today): confirm scope (prod vs POC tenant) and controls of interest
- Day 2: deliver assertion index (CSV + annotated PDF) mapping Redwood claims to CSA CCM sub-controls
- Day 3: provide runtime artifact bundle for the 14-day window (logs, sample telemetry, KV cache snapshot and extraction notes)

We have attached an initial assertion index (v1) which maps the controls you listed in the worksheet. It's intentionally concise — each row has: control_id, redwood_claim, evidence_name(s), owner.

Attachment: [redwood_csa_assertion_index_v1.pdf (PDF stub)]

Before we prepare the runtime bundle, two quick scope clarifications:
1) Confirm the tenant identifier you want us to pull (POC tenant vs a short-lived demo tenant).
2) Are the logs you requested allowed to include IPs/user-agents, or should we redact those fields prior to delivery? Our default is to redact PII.

Marissa — you'll take the lead on the assertion index and evidence packaging. Karthik — can you own the runtime log extraction and the KV cache notes?

If that's all good, we'll aim to drop the first artifacts to the Drive link below by EOD tomorrow.

Related link (incoming folder): https://drive.google.com/sentinel/poc-evidence

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Security Programs
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

---

From: Priya Sharma <security@sentinelhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CSA questions for Sentinel POC - control list and evidence

Naomi — thanks, that timeline works for us. A few clarifications from our side:

- Scope: POC tenant only (identifier: sentinel-poc-2026). No production data — please scope extraction to that tenant.
- Redaction: please remove client IPs and any user identifiers; request_id and timestamp are fine.
- We also need a short KMS attestation letter (one paragraph + pointer to rotation logs). If you can sign a brief attestation we can attach to our assessment pack.

I've shared a DocuSign envelope to the security@redwood.com alias with a brief attestation template. Please have someone on your security/compliance team sign it so we can include it in our packet. DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/documents?d=abc123

Attachment: [Sentinel_POC_Scope.pdf (PDF stub)]

If you can target the assertion index by EOD tomorrow (Tue) and the runtime bundle by Wed, we'll route to our reviewers.

Best,
Priya

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 13:47:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: CSA questions for Sentinel POC - control list and evidence (internal)

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding the thread (Priya confirmed POC tenant: sentinel-poc-2026). Action items and owners below.

Action checklist (short):
- Marissa: finalize redwood_csa_assertion_index_v1.pdf -> add evidence path column with Drive links; target: Tue 17:00 PST.
- Karthik: extract runtime telemetry for sentinel-poc-2026 (last 14 days). Redact IPs and user identifiers; keep request_id, latency, model_id, and timestamps. Provide KV cache extraction notes (how we sampled eviction events). Target: Wed 12:00 PST.
- Naomi: coordinate KMS attestation signature. I'll route the DocuSign envelope to Legal/Security for signature today.

Internal reference: csa_runtime_log_extraction_notes.md (internal runbook stub)

Please reply here when you pick up the tasks so I can update Priya.

Thanks — Naomi
